title: Stay on 30A Property Management: Blue Daze in Seacrest – Stay on 30A
meta_description: Stay on 30A Property Management: Blue Daze, your perfectly placed 30A getaway in the highly sought-after Magnolia Cottages by the Sea.
description_expanded: class="property_description"> Welcome to 'Blue Daze' , professionally managed by Stay on 30a, your perfectly placed 30A getaway in the highly sought-after Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, set between Alys & Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill & Seaside. This stunning vacation home offers the ideal combination of relaxation, style, and convenience for your next 30A escape. Step inside and experience the warm, inviting feel that makes Blue Daze such a guest favorite. Designed with comfort and relaxation in mind, this home blends coastal charm with functional, family-friendly living. The open-concept living area welcomes you with plush seating, soft coastal tones, and abundant natural light that creates a calming retreat after a day in the sun. Large windows and glass doors overlook the spacious screened-in porch, offering a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor living. The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need to prepare meals with ease, quality cookware, stainless steel appliances, and thoughtful touches designed to make cooking and gathering effortless.  Retreat to one of the thoughtfully appointed bedrooms, each complete with a streaming TV and its own ensuite bathroom, your private space to unwind after a day on 30A. The expansive screened-in porch is the heart of Blue Daze, a breezy haven perfect for morning coffee, evening cocktails, alfresco dining, or simply soaking in the quiet coastal atmosphere. Just a short stroll away, you’ll find the resort-style, zero-entry pool that Magnolia Cottages is known for. And just a half mile from the home guests can enjoy the community’s deeded beach access, offering quick and convenient trips to the sugar-white sands. To elevate your stay even more, take advantage of the included 6-seater golf cart and four adult bikes, giving you fun and flexible ways to explore 30A. Cruise to Rosemary, browse the boutiques of Alys, or bike over to The Big Chill for dinner and live music. This home is a true gem within Magnolia Cottages, combining inviting interiors, convenient amenities, and the charm of a perfectly located beach community. With resort-style pool access, deeded beach access, a 6-seater golf cart, and four adult bikes included, Blue Daze gives you everything you need for an effortless and unforgettable beach vacation. We invite you to make Blue Daze your home away from home on 30A. FEATURES: Resort-Style, Zero-Entry Community Pool Across The Street Private Deeded Beach Access 6-Seater Golf Cart 4 Bikes- Adult Large Screened in Front Porch with Seating Fully Equipped Kitchen Full Washer & Dryer Smart TVs Bunk Beds Gas Grill Complimentary Wifi Beach Gear 2 Dedicated Parking Spots Close to Rosemary + Alys Beach 1 Mile to The Big Chill ACCOMMODATIONS: Blue Daze accommodates up to 10 people: FIRST FLOOR: -Bedroom #1: King, with Ensuite -First Floor Hallway: Twin/Twin Bunk  SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom #2: King, with Ensuite -Bedroom #3: (2) Twin/Twin Bunks, with Ensuite **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Three parking spaces available (2 driveway & 1 along street). Included is a 6-seater golf cart & 4 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. COMMUNITY: Magnolia Cottages by the Sea offers a beloved coastal retreat for families seeking a memorable vacation. Located in the charming Seacrest, this section of Magnolia Cottages combines modern comforts with the timeless appeal of beachside living. Guests enjoy easy access to the Gulf Lakes public beach, making it simple to step out onto the soft, white sands and enjoy the sparkling waters that make 30A so special. After a day of sun and surf, unwind at the resort-style pool, perfectly set within the community’s natural wooded landscape a serene space to relax and recharge. The community’s dedication to preserving its natural beauty creates a peaceful, inviting atmosphere, perfect for quiet mornings, leisurely afternoons, and magical evenings with family. At Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, every moment is framed by the tranquility and charm of this coastal haven. NEARBY BEACH ACCESS 1. Private Deeded Beach Access is found at the end of Patina Blvd across Hwy 30A. You can rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) from the exclusive provider to enjoy this access. If you choose not to rent from the exclusive vendor, you can setup the beach chairs from the home behind the rented chairs or walk down to the public spaces on either side. Gate code found in Welcome Guide. 2. Gulf Lakes Access is on Scenic 30A about 1/4 mile east of Camp Creek Lake and about 100 yards east of Pelican Circle. Halfway down the boardwalk there is a bike rack and shower but no car parking. The dune walkover sits on a high bluff overlooking the gulf. 3. Seacrest Drive Access is on Scenic 30A at the intersection of Seacrest Drive. A short boardwalk leads to a dune walkover high atop a bluff overlooking the Gulf of Mexico. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including force porch. Additional cleaning charges of $500 will be charged if in violation. *Capacity for 2 vehicles in the driveway. *No parties or events.  *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Space must remain pet free! IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app. read more + less -
